SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.pack, p.flow, p.price_inr,
       ds.units_sold AS june_units, ds.revenue_inr AS june_revenue,
       ds.days_with_sales
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT sku, SUM(units_sold) AS units_sold, SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr,
         COUNT(*) AS days_with_sales
  FROM store.daily_sales
  WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY sku
) ds ON ds.sku = p.sku
ORDER BY p.sku;

SELECT d.date,
       ds.units_sold, ds.revenue_inr,
       ib.book_on_hand_close,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.reorder_point, f.order_up_to,
       f.book_on_hand, f.ordered_units,
       sa.audits, sa.on_shelf, sa.empty,
       sa.first_audit, sa.last_audit
FROM generate_series(DATE '2026-06-01', DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL '1 day') d(date)
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.date = d.date AND ds.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.date = d.date AND ib.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS date, COUNT(*) AS audits,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty,
         MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit, MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
  FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  GROUP BY audit_ts::date
) sa ON sa.date = d.date
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT 'shelf_audits' AS section, audit_ts::text AS ts, sku, status AS detail
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', count_ts::text, sku,
       'trigger=' || trigger || '; book_before=' || book_before || '; counted=' || counted || '; adjustment=' || adjustment
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', date::text, sku, reason || '; units=' || units
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY section, ts;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS item, MIN(date)::text AS first_date, MAX(date)::text AS last_date, COUNT(*)::text AS rows_or_audits
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits_5kg', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits_all', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.shelf_audits;

SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf') AS on_shelf,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty') AS empty
FROM store.shelf_audits
GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku;

SELECT date, units_sold, revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-05-20'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_max_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS june_5kg_sales_days,
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS june_5kg_units,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS june_5kg_pos_units,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS june_5kg_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'on shelf') AS june_5kg_on_shelf,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'empty') AS june_5kg_empty;

SELECT f.date, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.book_on_hand, f.ordered_units,
       ds.units_sold, ib.book_on_hand_close,
       sa.status AS audit_status, sa.audit_ts
FROM store.forecasts f
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.date=f.date AND ds.sku=f.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.date=f.date AND ib.sku=f.sku
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits sa ON sa.audit_ts::date=f.date AND sa.sku=f.sku
WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY f.date;

WITH atta_bills AS (
  SELECT bill_id, bill_ts, SUM(qty) AS bags
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY bill_id, bill_ts
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atta_bills, SUM(bags) AS bags,
       ROUND(AVG(bags),3) AS avg_bags_per_atta_bill,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bags=1) AS one_bag_bills,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bags>1) AS multi_bag_bills,
       MIN(bill_ts) AS first_bill, MAX(bill_ts) AS last_bill
FROM atta_bills;

SELECT audit_ts::date AS date, status,
       ds.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day,
       ROUND(f.forecast_units_per_day * p.price_inr, 2) AS forecast_revenue_at_retail
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=sa.sku
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.date=audit_ts::date AND ds.sku=sa.sku
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=audit_ts::date AND f.sku=sa.sku
WHERE sa.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT 'pos_lines' AS dataset, MIN(bill_ts)::text AS first_ts, MAX(bill_ts)::text AS last_ts, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_payments', MIN(ts)::text, MAX(ts)::text, COUNT(*) FROM payments.pos_payments
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.forecasts;

SELECT bill_id, bill_ts, qty
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY bill_ts
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 'pos_lines' AS dataset, MIN(bill_ts)::text AS first_ts, MAX(bill_ts)::text AS last_ts, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_payments', MIN(ts)::text, MAX(ts)::text, COUNT(*) FROM payments.pos_payments
UNION ALL SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.forecasts;

WITH atta_bills AS (
  SELECT bill_id, bill_ts, SUM(qty) AS bags
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY bill_id, bill_ts
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atta_bills, SUM(bags) AS bags,
       ROUND(AVG(bags),3) AS avg_bags_per_atta_bill,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bags=1) AS one_bag_bills,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bags>1) AS multi_bag_bills,
       MIN(bill_ts) AS first_bill, MAX(bill_ts) AS last_bill
FROM atta_bills;

WITH empty_audits AS (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS date
  FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND status = 'empty'
    AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
    AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT ea.date, f.forecast_units_per_day, ds.units_sold,
       GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - COALESCE(ds.units_sold, 0), 0) AS estimated_lost_bags,
       p.price_inr,
       ROUND(GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - COALESCE(ds.units_sold, 0), 0) * p.price_inr, 2) AS estimated_lost_sales_inr
FROM empty_audits ea
JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = ea.date AND f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.date = ea.date AND ds.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY ea.date;

SELECT sa.sku, sa.audit_ts::date AS date, sa.status,
       ds.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, ib.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.date=sa.audit_ts::date AND ds.sku=sa.sku
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=sa.audit_ts::date AND f.sku=sa.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.date=sa.audit_ts::date AND ib.sku=sa.sku
WHERE sa.status='empty'
ORDER BY sa.audit_ts, sa.sku;
